name: copilotprompts-m365-decision-log-generator-prompt
title: Generate a Structured Decision Log from a Meeting
shortDescription: Turn a Teams meeting transcript into an auditable decision log capturing each decision, its owner, rationale, reversibility, and review date.
longDescription: This prompt makes Microsoft 365 Copilot act as a decision archivist that scans a Teams meeting transcript strictly for decisions and outputs a structured Markdown decision log. It distinguishes reversible from irreversible decisions, assigns owners and review dates, and flags any ownerless decisions for follow-up, giving teams a lightweight governance and audit trail without re-reading the entire meeting.
